lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li₂V₂O₄F₂ (reduced formula LiV(OF)₂) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Li and V centers: each Li and V is surrounded by six neighbors, with Li coordinated by four F and two O, and V coordinated by two F and four O. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Li and V octahedra and between Li and O octahedra, with edge-sharing also observed between like Li and like V octahedra.
